description: Healthcare data processing pipeline may not properly anonymize Protected Health Information (PHI) before storage or transmission, leading to potential HIPAA violations and exposure of sensitive patient data.
The system uses a general Lambda role with broad permissions and lacks fine-grained access controls, potentially allowing unauthorized access to sensitive healthcare data.
The VPC configuration allows broad outbound access and has potential network exposure points through API Gateway and ELB configurations.
The system lacks proper TLS configuration and certificate management through AWS Certificate Manager, potentially exposing data in transit.
The system may not properly manage data retention and deletion according to healthcare compliance requirements.
The system lacks comprehensive monitoring for data exfiltration and may log sensitive information inappropriately.
